definitions.explanation: A book with pictures and descriptions of items in a particular category, such as animals, plants, or insects.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}に{昆虫|こんちゅう}{図鑑|ずかん}を{買|か}ってあげた。
examples.english: I bought an insect encyclopedia for my child.

examples.japanese: {植物|しょくぶつ}{図鑑|ずかん}で{花|はな}の{名前|なまえ}を{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: I looked up the flower's name in a plant reference book.

examples.japanese: {恐竜|きょうりゅう}{図鑑|ずかん}は{子供|こども}たちに{人気|にんき}がある。
examples.english: Dinosaur encyclopedias are popular with children.

notes:
{図鑑|ずかん} is an illustrated reference book, typically organized by category (animals, plants, etc.) with pictures and descriptions.

Common types:
- {昆虫|こんちゅう}{図鑑|ずかん} (insect encyclopedia)
- {植物|しょくぶつ}{図鑑|ずかん} (plant encyclopedia)
- {動物|どうぶつ}{図鑑|ずかん} (animal encyclopedia)
- {恐竜|きょうりゅう}{図鑑|ずかん} (dinosaur encyclopedia)
- {魚|さかな}{図鑑|ずかん} (fish encyclopedia)
- {鳥|とり}{図鑑|ずかん} (bird encyclopedia)

Related words:
- {百科事典|ひゃっかじてん} (encyclopedia - text-focused)
- {辞典|じてん} (dictionary)
- {絵本|えほん} (picture book - for stories)
